input-field.name: Enabled
input-field.label: Enable verified local tax calculation
启用本地税额计算
input-field.helpText: Configure nexus, synchronize current data and verify your tax treatment before enabling. Managed US checkout is blocked while disabled.

input-field.name: NexusStates
input-field.label: States where you collect sales tax (comma separated, e.g. CA)
需要代收销售税的州（逗号分隔，例如 CA）
input-field.helpText: Required. Outside these states managed items are tax-free. Verified sources support CA and WA. Other nexus states block checkout.

input-field.name: OfficialAddressVerification
input-field.label: Allow background California address verification with CDTFA
允许后台向加州 CDTFA 核验收货地址
input-field.helpText: Sends shipping street, city and ZIP to the official California tax authority. No names, email, items or order amounts are sent. Results are cached locally for the current day and dataset. Unverified addresses block checkout while the async worker verifies them; refresh checkout shortly. Review CDTFA privacy and terms before enabling.
开启后，后台任务会向 CDTFA 发送收货街道、城市和 ZIP；不发送姓名、邮箱、商品或订单金额。结果缓存在本地，仅限当前日期和税率版本。尚未核验时暂时阻止下单，请稍后刷新。开启前请阅读使用条款及隐私说明。

input-field.name: FreightTaxable
input-field.label: Tax managed shipping charges
对托管运输方式的运费计税
input-field.helpText: Merchant tax policy for supported general merchandise. This is not an automatic determination of freight taxability.
